title: Fuzzer: `RenderSceneBuffersRD.create_texture` crashes Godot
body:

### Steps to reproduce

Run this script:

```gdscript
extends Node

func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	for i in get_children():
		i.queue_free()

	var temp_variable224 = RenderSceneBuffersRD.new()
	temp_variable224.create_texture(StringName("2541346514"), StringName("."), -39, -1, -68, Vector2i(-43, -76), -22, -73, false, false)

	get_tree().quit()
```

Or use the attached `mrp.zip`:

```
godot --headless --path mrp/ Node.tscn
```

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29945424/mrp.zip)
